column1: # Two turns that touch every branch of the ladder, in the order the events would
# arrive. `lane` is what the pane reports after the row's hook has fired.
# The rows a successful turn never produces are here on purpose. A permission
# request is the only thing that puts a Mastra Code pane in the blocked lane, and
# PermissionResult is its only resolver; if that resolver were dropped the pane
# would latch on blocked, which is the failure this file exists to make visible.
# The sub-agent pair is here for the same reason in the other direction: neither
# SubagentStart nor SubagentEnd may return the pane to idle on its own, because a
# sub-agent finishing hands the pane back to its parent's work.
